positioning: MetrAIyux 0S is the client-facing autonomous business command deck. SkyeGateFS27 is the gate that gives those decks identity, event evidence, key control, and deployment tracking. Together they let Gray sell websites as sovereign web infrastructure, not disposable pages.
sales_rule: Lead with the buyer's operating pain, then route them to the live proof surface that answers that pain. Do not narrate the architecture as internal setup instructions. Do not expose tokens, mirror secrets, database URLs, or owner-only admin playbooks.

surfaces.name: SkyeGateFS27 Proof Surface
surfaces.audience: buyers, partners, founder-led clients, technical evaluators
surfaces.purpose: Explains how FS27 validates users, mirrors platform events, manages admin-controlled keys, and connects to MetrAIyux 0S without publishing secrets.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a prospect asks what makes the deployment more serious than a website.

surfaces.name: SkyeGateFS27 Actual Gate
surfaces.privacy: public entry with protected admin lanes
surfaces.purpose: Live control-plane entry for admin login, dashboard, user key request, smoke testing, monitor events, platform control, and gate-owned operations.
surfaces.sales_use: Use after the proof surface when the buyer is ready to see the gate itself.

surfaces.name: MetrAIyux 0S Full System
surfaces.audience: buyers, operators, prospects who need to understand the command deck
surfaces.privacy: public shell with protected admin/API lanes
surfaces.purpose: Live 17-brain business command deck: public pages, admin automation, customer SaaS, proof vault, AE assets, calculators, governance, and deployment routes.
surfaces.sales_use: Use as the primary live demo for what a client can receive with their own branding and deployment.

surfaces.name: MetrAIyux 0S Public Spectacle
surfaces.purpose: Public overview for the larger system. It explains value and routes qualified interest into the deeper MetrAIyux site.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when the buyer needs a clean first look before seeing the full command deck.

surfaces.name: MetrAIyux Public Brain Wall
surfaces.audience: buyers, prospects, partners, AEs, technical evaluators
surfaces.purpose: Shows the 17-brain model with portraits, operating-room screenshots, resume links, and buyer-safe proof routes.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a prospect needs to see that the brains have visible roles, rooms, and supporting proof instead of vague AI claims.

surfaces.name: Skye Ecosystem Portal
surfaces.purpose: Connects the deployed public overview, full command deck, FS27 proof gate, legal center, file vault, and related Skye surfaces.
surfaces.sales_use: Use after a buyer understands the main system and wants to inspect the broader deployed ecosystem.

surfaces.name: Main Automation Brain
surfaces.purpose: Owner-side command brain that validates Skyegate or legacy admin tokens, routes cabinet work, records receipts, and uses the Worker when authenticated.
surfaces.sales_use: Mention as the protected owner/admin lane. Do not send public buyers here unless the operator chooses to demo it safely.

surfaces.name: Sales Enablement Command Library
surfaces.purpose: Discovery blueprint, objection handling, outbound sequences, demo room script, closing room, and AE proof packet.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a buyer asks how the system helps sell, follow up, and move deals.

surfaces.name: Client OS
surfaces.purpose: Client onboarding, document request, escalation desk, renewal review, and status board surfaces.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a company loses track of client work after the sale.

surfaces.name: Live Proof Router
surfaces.purpose: Interactive sales router that matches buyer pain to live proof surfaces, including the FS27 gate map and the MetrAIyux command deck.
surfaces.sales_use: Use as the human-feeling guided route when a prospect wants to understand what matters to them specifically.

surfaces.name: Skyes Over London Reviews Proof Wall
surfaces.audience: prospects, customers, AEs, client-success operators, proof-seeking buyers
surfaces.purpose: Public proof wall and 3D review atlas for Skyes Over London service experience, client proof, review categories, and service-lane trust signals.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when prospects ask for client proof, testimonials, service experience, or examples of what customers say after working with Skyes Over London.

surfaces.name: Skyes Over London Live Review Intake
surfaces.audience: clients and customers who want to leave feedback about their experience
surfaces.privacy: public intake with 0S moderation before publication
surfaces.purpose: Client-facing form for submitting a new Skyes Over London review into the 0S QA queue before any public proof-wall publication.
surfaces.sales_use: Use after a client says they had a good experience or wants to share feedback. Send the intake link, then explain that 0S QA reviews submissions before public posting.

surfaces.name: 0S Review QA Queue
surfaces.privacy: operator token required for live queue actions
surfaces.purpose: Moderation surface for approving, rejecting, batching, and exporting live review submissions before production proof-wall publication.
surfaces.sales_use: Mention only as the owner-side QA gate. Do not send customers here; send customers to the live review intake instead.

brain_guidance.gray-london-skyes-brain: Frame the system as sovereign web infrastructure: public site, command deck, auth gate, proof loop, and client-specific deployment strategy.
brain_guidance.celeste-monroe-brain: Sell by listening first. Ask where work breaks down, then route the prospect to the one live surface that proves the relevant capability.
brain_guidance.orion-hayes-brain: Explain technical depth in plain language: FS27 validates identity, MetrAIyux routes work, Cloudflare serves the system, and event receipts prove activity.
brain_guidance.0meg4kai-security-brain: Keep buyer demos away from owner-only controls. Flag any request that touches secrets, customer isolation, connector publishing, payments, contracts, legal claims, or admin tokens.
brain_guidance.site-operator-brain: Route customer feedback to the review intake, route proof-seeking prospects to the review wall, and route publication decisions through the 0S QA queue.
brain_guidance.adrian-cross-brain: When a client wants to talk about their experience, thank them and route them to the Skyes Over London Live Review Intake. When a prospect asks what customers say, route them to the Reviews Proof Wall.
brain_guidance.valentina-reyes-brain: Use the Reviews Proof Wall as public social proof. Keep review copy proof-safe and do not invent outcomes, client names, or consent.
brain_guidance.victor-saint-brain: Review submissions before publication. Confirm consent, public-name preference, category fit, and proof safety; only five approved unpublished reviews should be batched for production.

public_claim_boundary: Say the system is deployed and has live proof surfaces.
Say FS27 is the auth/event gate and MetrAIyux is the command deck consuming it.
Say client deployments can be packaged with public site, admin command deck, proof routing, and tenant-safe controls.
Do not promise fully autonomous legal, hiring, payment, tax, or contracting actions without human approval and professional review.
Do not expose admin tokens, database URLs, mirror secrets, provider API keys, or private setup instructions.
Do not claim a review is public, approved, or production-published until it has passed 0S QA and the five-review batch publish step.
Do not expose reviewer email addresses, private proof notes, or the 0S review admin token in public answers.
